description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans' built-in serializers, verifying serialization and deserialization of various .NET and Orleans-specific data types, including complex classes, collections, structs, enums, and references. It also tests object identities, circular references, and type resolution scenarios.

classes.name: BuiltInSerializerTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying Orleans built-in serializers and their handling of various data types.

methods.name: OrleansSerializationLoop
methods.description: Helper method to perform serialization and deserialization cycles for testing, with optional wire serialization.

methods.name: ValidateDictionary
methods.description: Validates that a deserialized dictionary matches the source.

methods.name: ValidateDictionaryContent
methods.description: Checks the contents of a deserialized dictionary against the source.

methods.name: ValidateReadOnlyDictionary
methods.description: Validates reading from a deserialized ReadOnlyDictionary.

methods.name: ValidateSortedDictionary
methods.description: Checks that a sorted dictionary is correctly serialized/deserialized.

methods.name: ValidateSortedList
methods.description: Checks that a sorted list is correctly serialized/deserialized.

methods.name: ValidateList
methods.description: Checks that expected list matches result list.

methods.name: ValidateArray
methods.description: Checks that arrays are correctly serialized/deserialized.

methods.name: ValidateArrayOfArrays
methods.description: Checks nested array of arrays deserialization.

methods.name: ValidateArrayOfArrayOfArrays
methods.description: Checks nested array of array of arrays deserialization.
